events.title: Celanese Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Decline Y/Y
events.body: CE's Q1 earnings jump but miss estimates as sales dip on weak end markets. It expects a stronger Q2 with price gains, higher volumes and improved cash flow outlook.
